title: Rebuilding the West Maui Senior Center
summary: The department said in April 2026 that $27 million in FEMA (federal disaster aid) funds will help rebuild the West Maui Senior Center, which it called a key hub for Lahaina kūpuna (elders), offering meals, rides and social connection. The center was lost in the August 2023 wildfire. A year earlier, in April 2025, the department had asked for $250,000 to plan a new center.
